dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pyq7](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pyq7) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on May 11 2025 6km S of Lhatse. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 29.0353 longitude 87.6347. It impacted 43426 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
